title: IVIA Measurement Record
description: Schema for recording an IVIA v2.0 measurement session. Two independent layers: CAPA_IVIA_IA (language models) and CAPA_IPS_SERP (search engines). Developed by Nitten Marketing SpA.

entity.description: Name of the entity being evaluated

domain.description: Primary domain of the entity (e.g. nittenmkt.cl)

layer.description: Measurement layer. CAPA_IVIA_IA for language models, CAPA_IPS_SERP for search engines.

model.description: AI model or search engine used for the evaluation

P.description: Presence: proportion of queries where entity appears (0-1)

F.description: Frequency: normalized mention intensity (0-1, original scale 0-3 divided by 3)

PR.description: Precision raw score (1=incorrect, 2=incorrect attributes, 3=partially correct, 4=correct and aligned, 5=correct with own terminology). Normalization applied in formula: PR/4 for CAPA_IVIA_IA, PR/5 for CAPA_IPS_SERP.

formula.description: IVIA formula. Use first for CAPA_IVIA_IA, second for CAPA_IPS_SERP.

ivia_score.description: Final IVIA score (0-100 scale. Scores above 100 are valid for CAPA_IVIA_IA when PR=5.)

chained.description: True if this prompt chains from the previous query in the same session (applies to comparative prompt in standard v2.0 set)

own_language.description: True if the model used terminology specific to the entity

appeared_with.description: Competitors or other entities mentioned alongside the evaluated entity

notes.description: General notes about the measurement session
